- AppFrame.tsx:~2360 — the ▼/▲ stepper clamp (`Math.min(MAX_FLOOR, ...)`)

- `isoStage.ts:173` `setLevel` = `Math.max(0, Math.round(level))` — ground clamp only; camera target lifts to `level × 3m` (384m at 128) through pure math, no range limit.
- Storey cutaway: `visibleStoreyPieces(pieces, floor, wallsDown)` filters on integer `piece.floor` (fallback `Math.round(y/3)` at pieces.ts:218) — no cap.
- Host validator: `resolvePlacement` (pieces.ts:184) computes `y = terrainY + floor × 3`; `build.zig validatePlacement` (framework/game/build.zig:693) checks only catalog id, edit-kind acceptance, and position finiteness — **no storey cap in Zig**, y=384 validates clean. Nothing to report/fix host-side.
